business_summary: Coastal Corporation Limited engages in the process, production, and distribution of sea food products in India. It offers sea caught and aquaculture shrimps, including sea tiger, whites, pink brown, vannamei, and black tiger shrimps. The company also provides shrimp products such as, raw, cooked, individually quick frozen, peeled, deveined, butterfly, breaded, skewered, and other value-added ready to cook and ready to eat products. It offers its products under the Coastal, Coastal Premium, Coastal Gold, Jewel, and President brand names. The company exports its products to the United States, Europe, the United Kingdom, Canada, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Korea, and Sri Lanka. Coastal Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Visakhapatnam, India.
